content.short: Blink provides one-tap deposit infrastructure for onchain applications.
content.description: Blink reduces onchain deposits to a single tap, handling the routing and conversion behind that action so the user does not choose a chain or bridge. Every additional decision in a deposit flow costs conversion, which is the entire rationale for products that collapse the sequence into one action.
content.meta: Onchain deposits reduced to a single tap, with routing and conversion handled behind it.
